label.label: Label
label.description: Text shown before the percent in the bar. Empty shows just the percent.

show_glyph.label: Show glyph
show_glyph.description: Show a glyph before the bar text.

glyph.label: Glyph
glyph.description: Glyph shown before the bar text.

metric.label: Bar metric
metric.description: Which usage window the bar and panel hero show: rolling (24h), weekly, or monthly.

refresh_minutes.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
refresh_minutes.description: How often the plugin re-fetches usage from the API.

warn_threshold.label: Warning threshold (%)
warn_threshold.description: Usage at or above this percent turns yellow.

critical_threshold.label: Critical threshold (%)
critical_threshold.description: Usage at or above this percent turns red.

debug_mode.label: Debug mode
debug_mode.description: Skip the API and control each window's percent from the panel (no API key required).

panel.title: OpenCode Usage
panel.unconfigured_desc: Store your OpenCode Go API key in the desktop keyring to fetch usage.
panel.debug_desc: API is skipped — set each window's percent to test the colors and the bar.

error.offline: Request failed — check the network or offline mode
error.keyring_store_failed: Couldn't store the key in the keyring (is it unlocked?)
